name: enterprise-lms-certification-platform
description: A realistic enterprise learning management and certification platform built as a TypeScript modular monolith learning codebase.

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @lms/api & npm run dev --workspace @lms/web
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @lms/domain && npm run build --workspace @lms/api && npm run build --workspace @lms/web && npm run build --workspace @lms/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @lms/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace @lms/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @lms/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @lms/worker
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
